reader.requirement: At --std 85, a figurative constant in a VALUE clause or associated with a data item (MOVE receiver, comparison operand) is repeated character by character to at least the item's size and truncated on the right to max(1, the item's character positions), before and independent of any JUSTIFIED clause, for every receiver class 85 admits (alphanumeric, alphabetic, edited, group, reference-modified, variable-length group, and numeric under the obsolete ALL-literal association).

edition-consulted.switches: via GateSr3 -> ConstructRegistry.Check(Constructs.AllLiteralMulticharNumericRemoved2002): a multi-character ALL literal associated with a numeric/numeric-edited item is accepted at 85 (the SRL3.2 obsolete element) and COBOL0902 at 2002+; the fill itself is the same code at every edition

reader.edition-search: The sizing paths (MoveEmitter whole-width fill / EmitText.RepeatToWidth, the edited arm, PlaceRenderer.WriteFill -> StrSpliceInto repeat, CompareFig) take no edition parameter; grepped _edition/Edition/CobolVersion in MoveEmitter.cs (none) and read FigurativeAssociation.cs for the edition rows.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only legality, not value; MOVE ALL "12" TO a numeric or numeric-edited item runs at 85 (12121 / 1212) and is COBOL0902 at 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers ALL literals into reference-modified receivers (incl. a group, a RENAMES, a numeric ref-mod); not exercised: JUSTIFIED receivers (MOVE and VALUE), truncation of a longer ALL literal, size-1 receiver, edited and alphabetic receivers, group VALUE, ODO groups, comparisons in both operand orders, and numeric association at 85
